spans.s:
(इ) वकि r. 1st cl. (वंकते)
1 To be crooked, (literally or figuratively); to be curved or bent, to be depraved or wicked.
2 To bend, to make crooked.
3 To go.

m. (-कः)
1 A crane, (Ardea nivea.)
2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
3

KUVERA.
4

The name of a demon.
5 A small apparatus for calcining or subliming metals or minerals, consisting of two crucibles, one inverted over the other, luted together and placed over a fire.
E.
वच to speak, or वकि to be crooked, aff. घञ् or अच्; in the latter case the nasal augment is not inserted.

r. 1st cl. (वक्कते)
To go.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to a crane.
n. (-कं)
A flight of cranes.
E.
वक, and अण् or अञ् aff.

f. (-का)
A sort of fish.

n. (-जित्)
A name of BHĪMA.
E.
वक a demon, and जित् the conqueror.

m. (-पः)
Compound perfume: see वृकधूप.

m. (-नः)
BHĪMA.
E.
वक the demon, and निसूदन destroyer.

m. (-ष्पः)
A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.)
E.
वक curving, from वकि to be crooked, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-त्तिः)
A false or hypocritical devotee: see वकव्रतिन्.
E.
वक, and वृत्ति livelihood.

m. (-री)
BHĪMA.
E.
वक the demon, and वैरिन् a foe.

m. (-ती)
A false devotee, a religious hypocrite, or one who assumes the appearance of devotion or meditation, for interested purposes.
E.
वक a crane, व्रत observance, and इनि aff.; compared to the crane, who stands by a pool demure and sly, and apparently absorbed in contemplation, till he sees a fish on which to dart; also with ठक्, aff. [] वकव्रतिक, and derived from वक, and चर who goes, वकचर or वकव्रतचर m. (-रः) &c.; see वैडालव्रतिक.

f. (-ची)
A sort of fish.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Mimusops elengi.)
f. (-ली)
A sort of drug, commonly Kākolī.
E.
वक to be crooked, aff. उलच्.

f. (-का)
1 A small crane.
2 The branch of a tree bent by the wind.
E.
वक a crane, or crooked, ईर to go or be, aff. उकन्.

m. (-टः)
A crane.
E.
वक to be crooked. ओटच् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Fit or proper to be said or spoken, to be spoken or uttered.
2 Vile, bad, reprehensible.
3 Subject, dependant.
4 Low, base.
n. (-व्यं)
1 A rule, a dictum, a sentence.
2 Speech.
E.
वच to speak, and तव्य aff., of the future participle.

f. (-ता)
1 Blame, reprehension.
2 The nature or property of what is to be said, or the occasion for it.
E.
तल् added to the last.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Desirous of speaking.
E.
वक्तु for वक्तुम् to speak, काम desire.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
1 Speaking, a speaker.
2 Loquacious, talkative.
3 Speaking well or sensibly, eloquent.
4 Wise, learned.
5 Speaking truly or truth, honest, sincere.
m. (-क्ता)
1 An expounder, a teacher.
2 An orator, a speaker.
E.
वच् to speak, तृच् participial aff.

n. (-क्त्रं)
1 The mouth or face.
2 A sort of garment.
3 Metre, verse, especially of the

Vedas.
4

A plant: see तगरसूल.
E.
वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. त्र.

m. (-रः)
A tooth.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, and खुर a hoof.

m. (-जः)
A Brahman.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) ज born.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A musical instrument, played on with the mouth.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, ताल tune; it may also signify, making a noise with the mouth, by striking it with the hand at the moment of uttering sound.

m. (-ण्डः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
वक्त्र, and तुण्ड beak or nose, having the proboscis of an elephant.

m. (-ट्टः)
A bag containing corn tied round a horse's head.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, and पट्ट a cloth.

m. (-दी)
Pungency, pungent or acrid flavour.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, and भेदिन् what cuts.

m. (-धी)
A lime.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, and शोधिन् what cleanses; also वक्त्रशोधन m. (-नः.)

m. (-वः)
Saliva.
E.
वक्त्र the mouth, and आसव wine.

mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं)
1 Crooked, curved, bowed or bent.
2 Cruel, malignant.
3 Dishonest, fraudulent.
4 Indirect, evasive.
n. (-क्रं)
The winding course of a river or water-fall, the arm or bend of a stream.
2 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
m. (-क्रः)
1 A name of

SATURN.
2
The planet

MARS.
3
RUDRA or Ś

IVA.
4

The demon TRIPURA.
E.
वकि to go crookedly, रक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ड्गः)
A sabre or scimitar.
E.
वक्र crooked, and खड्ग a sword; also वक्रखड्गकः.

mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि)
1 Who or what goes tortuously.
2 Fraudulent, dishonest.
E.
वक्र, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-वः)
A camel.
E.
वक्र crooked, ग्रीवा the neck.

m. (-ञ्चुः)
A parrot.
E.
वक्र crooked, and चञ्चु the beak.

Crookedness.
2

Wickedness.
3

Craft, cunning.
4 Evasive or indirect speech.
E.
वक्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, वक्रत्वं.

m. (-ण्डः)
A parrot.
E.
वक्र crooked, तुण्ड a face.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A hog.
E.
वक्र crooked, and दंष्ट्र a tusk.

m. (-क्रः)
A low or depraved man.
2 A parrot.
E.
वक्र crooked, and नक्र the nose, &c.

m. (-कः)
An owl.
E.
वक्र crooked, and नासिका the nose.

m. (-च्छः)
A dog.
E.
वक्र crooked, and पुच्छ a tail; also वक्रपुच्छिक.

m. (-ष्पः)
The Sesbana grandiflora.
E.
वक्र crooked, and पुष्प the flower.

m. (-धिः)
A dog.
E.
वक्र crooked, बालधि a tail.

n. (-तं)
Indirect speech, equivoque, evasion.
E.
वक्र crooked, and भणित spoken.

m. (-मः)
Flight, retreat.
E.
अव reverse, क्रम to go, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected.

m. (-क्त्रः)
A hog.
E.
वक्र crooked, and वक्त्र a face.

n. (-ग्रं)
A plant, commonly Betu.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A goose.
2 The ruddy goose.
E.
वक्र bending, अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-क्रिः-क्रिः-क्रि)
Speaking falsely, uttering untruths, prevaricating, lying.
E.
वक्र to be crooked, (metaph.) क्रिन् aff.

mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि)
1

Crooked.
2

Dishonest, fraudulent.
m. (-क्री)
A Jaina or Bauddha.
E.
वक्र crooked, fraudulent, इनि aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Bent, curved.
E.
वकि to go crookedly, क्रिमच् aff.

m. (-मा)
1 Crookedness, curvature.
2 Craftiness, cunning.
E.
बक्र, and इमनिच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Curving, bending, distorting.
E.
वक्र, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bent, made crooked.
E.
वक्र, and कृत made, च्चि aug.

m. (-वः)
1 Curvature, curve.
2 Fraudulent or dishonest disposition.
E.
वक्री, and भाव property, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bent, crooked.
2 Dishonest.
E.
वक्र, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Equivoque, evasion, pun, the covert expression of something else than the words used naturally imply, either from the manner in which they are uttered, or some other sense of which they are susceptible.
2 Hint, insinuation.
3 Sarcasm.
E.
वक्र crooked, dishonest, and उक्ति speech.

f. (-का)
A gentle smile, one in which the teeth are not shewn.
E.
वक्र crooked, ओष्ठ the lip, and कन् aff., fem. form; also वक्रोष्टिः.

r. 1st cl. (वक्षति)
1 To be angry.
2 To accumulate.

(इ) वाक्षि r. 10th cl. (वाङ्क्षति)
To desire.

f. (-नी)
Wife of the bosom.
E.
वक्षस्, and सम्मर्द्दिनी who rubs.

n. (-णं)
The breast: see वक्षस्.

n. (-क्षः)
The breast, the bosom, the chest.
m. (-क्षाः)
An ox, (confined to the Vedas.)
E.
वच to speak, or वक्ष to accumulate, aff. असुन्, in the first case सुट् is inserted; again वह to bear, असुन् aff., सुट् augment, and the deriv. irr.

n. (-लं)
The breast, the heart.
E.
वक्षस्, and स्थल place.

n. (-जं)
The female breast.
E.
वक्षस् the breast or chest, and ज born.

m. (-हः)
The female breast.
E.
वक्षस् the chest, and रुह what rises.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being to be said or described.
E.
वच् to say, desid. pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-ची)
A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
वा wind, and कुच् to contract, क aff., form irr.

n. (-हं)
Quarrel, dispute.
E.
वाच्, and कलह disturbance.

m. (-रः)
A wife's brother.
E.
वाच् a speech, a phrase, and कीर parrot: having giving rise to a proverb; as a cock parrot is, so is the hen; i. e. of the same breed and disposition.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Frivolous, inconsistent, (in speech.)
E.
वाक्, and चपल changeable.

n. (-ल्यं)
Gossipping, chattering, idle or improper talk.
E.
वाक् speech, चापल्य unsteadiness.

n. (-लं)
Prevarication, equivocation.
E.
वाक् speech, छल disguise, fraud.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Equivocating, evasive.
E.
वाक्छल, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु)
Eloquent, able in speech.
E.
वाक्, and पटु skilful.

f. (-ता)
Eloquence.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वाकपटुत्वं.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Eloquent.
m. (-तिः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
वाक् speech, and पति master.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Suitable or seasonable for discourse.
E.
वाक्, and पथ path.

n. (-ष्यं)
Abuse, scurrility, defamation, wordy violence or assault.
E.
वाक् speech, पारुष्य violence.

n. (-क्यं)
1 A sentence.
2 A rule or aphorism.
3

Speech.
4

(In astronomy,) The solar process for all astronomical computations.
E.
वच to speak, ण्यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
Refuting or criticising an assertion.
E.
वाक्य, and खण्डन breaking.

m. (-गः)
Employment or application of speech or language.
E.
वाक्य, and प्रयोग application.

m. (-सः)
Syntax, order, or arrangement of a sentence.
E.
वाक्य, and विन्यास disposition.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Eloquent.
E.
वाक्य, and विशारद skilful.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Contained in a sentence.
2 Obedient, attentive.
E.
वाक्य, and स्थ what stays; also वाक्यस्थित, &c.
